dominant_strengths: Clean type hierarchy with tabular figures, monospaced emails, and consistent label/value contrast across rows
Restrained dark palette with semantic status pills (green/amber/gray/red) that read instantly without overwhelming
Solid table craft: sortable headers, avatar initials, summary footer with Total ARR anchor
dominant_weaknesses: Highly conventional SaaS table layout—nothing distinctive in structure, density, or interaction beyond Linear/Notion conventions
Empty revenue cell uses a bare em-dash with no tooltip or affordance, and Last Activity lacks visual weighting for recency
Vast empty canvas below the table wastes vertical real estate and weakens compositional balance
fix_priorities: Introduce a distinguishing detail—sparkline revenue trend, recency heat indicator, or grouped sections—to escape generic-table feel
Reflow page so table fills viewport or add contextual side panel/metrics to use lower canvas
Strengthen empty-state treatment for missing revenue and add hover row affordances
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity leads with strong scanability, visceral polish is competent but understated, and reflective memorability is low due to template familiarity.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it executes the customer data-table brief competently and legibly, though without a signature idea that elevates it above category baseline.
